name: cmd_library_buildPreviews
description: Build Previews (command `library.buildPreviews`). Params: {size?: standard (2048 px, or `edge`) | full (1:1), ids?, wait?: bool} — render the grid thumbnail and loupe view of the selected photos (else all in view) into the preview cache, in the background unless `wait` → {total, done, failed, running}.
